text:
deploy-bot: deploy job for service 'embedder' (redwood/embedder:2026-03-12-rc3) started. pushing to ECR... ERROR: invalid manifest annotations, push aborted.

infra-bot: put-image error: InvalidParameter: Invalid manifest annotations: provenance.dsig mismatch (Code=InvalidParameter)

saharn: saw the alert — is this blocking the prod canary?

matt: yes, canary didn't pick up new image. ECR rejected the manifest because cosign attestation header changed after a rebuild.

jae: we still have a GCR mirror for the last successful build: gcr.io/redwood/embedder@sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99ddeeff00aabbccddeeff00112233

release-oncall: decision time: roll back canary to previous digest, or try to re-publish with fixed provenance. which is lower risk?

infra-bot: audit note: cosign job failed earlier with 401 to KMS; attestation not attached. put-image ultimately failed validation server-side.

matt: low-risk path = rollback canary to the GCR digest and hold. higher-risk = re-run cosign and republish immediately. Ops input?

saharn: we cannot relax prod provenance policy. if we republish we must ensure attestation present. do we have the signing key access?

jae: cosign logs show transient auth failure at 23:01 (Buildkite #4521). I can re-run cosign against the same image, should be quick.

ops-docs: provisional release note: "embedder: canary pinned to previous digest due to signing attestation failure; republish planned after cosign fix." I'll file it once we pick approach.

matt: plan: 1) rollback canary to gcr digest now (staging/prod canary only) 2) jae re-runs cosign and republishes to ECR with correct annotations 3) verify staging smoke, then swap canary if good. tagging note: pin by digest not tag.

saharn: also schedule a change window tonight 00:00 UTC just in case we need to force a republish during low traffic.

matt: executing rollback now — kubectl patch deployment embedder-canary -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"embedder","image":"gcr.io/redwood/embedder@sha256:aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff66aa77bb88cc99ddeeff00aabbccddeeff00112233"}]}}}}'

matt: rollback applied at 1780123200 :thumbsup:

jae: re-running cosign now against built image sha256:cc22dd33ee44ff55... cosign attach --key kms://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-key --signature sig.json --bundle bundle.json

jae: cosign attach succeeded, republishing to ECR in 2m.

deploy-bot: publish job completed: pushed redwood/embedder@sha256:cc22dd33ee44ff55aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff0011 status=success

matt: note — new digest is sha256:cc22dd33ee44ff55aabbccddeeff00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff0011. We'll keep canary pinned until smoke tests pass.

saharn: smoke tests on staging passed, canary swap planned in 30m. please monitor latency/errors.

ops-docs: created release note: https://docs.redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-12-embedder-signing-fix (adds context, rollback digest, and follow-up action to add KMS retry logic)

release-oncall: summary of actions: rollback canary -> done, re-run cosign -> done, republish -> done, scheduled swap after smoke tests. leaving this thread open for 1h then closing. thanks all :rocket:

matt: logging the incident ticket for follow-up: INFRA-1789 — investigate cosign KMS auth flakiness and add retries in the pipeline.

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1789 (Priority=P2)

release-oncall: closing thread once swap completes. cheers.
